Persistent Runtime Journal initializes private storage, then stores Insights, Power Control and Daily Target Accuracy in the private hpvc-data/runtime-history.json journal (using /homeassistant or /homeassistant_config), resets them at local midnight, and restores current-day history and restores any active negative-price override regardless of date before runtime evaluation starts.

name: Publish HPVC daily history atomically
info: Atomically publishes the journal. The return-code output confirms success before the in-memory change signature advances.

command:
set -eu
if [ -d /homeassistant ] && [ -w /homeassistant ]; then BASE=/homeassistant; elif [ -d /homeassistant_config ] && [ -w /homeassistant_config ]; then BASE=/homeassistant_config; else echo "No writable Home Assistant config mount" >&2; exit 1; fi
DATA="$BASE/hpvc-data"
JOURNAL="$DATA/runtime-history.json"
mkdir -p "$DATA"
if [ ! -f "$JOURNAL" ]; then
  LEGACY=""
  [ -f /homeassistant/hpvc-insight-history.json ] && LEGACY=/homeassistant/hpvc-insight-history.json
  [ -z "$LEGACY" ] && [ -f /homeassistant_config/hpvc-insight-history.json ] && LEGACY=/homeassistant_config/hpvc-insight-history.json
  if [ -n "$LEGACY" ]; then
    node - "$LEGACY" "$JOURNAL" <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const legacyPath = process.argv[2];
const journalPath = process.argv[3];
let legacy = null;
try { legacy = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(legacyPath, 'utf8')); } catch (_) {}
const valid = legacy && typeof legacy === 'object' && typeof legacy.date === 'string' && Array.isArray(legacy.entries);
const journal = valid ? {
  version: 1,
  date: legacy.date,
  savedAt: Date.now(),
  insightLog: { date: legacy.date, entries: legacy.entries },
  activity: [],
  activityMeta: null,
  reportInsightHistory: null,
  dailyAccuracy: null,
  migratedFromLegacyInsightHistory: true
} : {};
fs.writeFileSync(journalPath, JSON.stringify(journal));
NODE
  else
    printf '%s' '{}' > "$JOURNAL"
  fi
fi
ln -sfn "$DATA" /tmp/hpvc-data-root
printf 'ready\n'

name: Evaluate Battery Telemetry Health
func:
// Interpret the fresh per-battery telemetry health collected on HPVC Inputs.
const hpvc = msg.hpvc || {};
if (hpvc.halted) return msg;

const source = Array.isArray(hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetryHealth)
    ? hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetryHealth
    : [];
const hbcBatteryTelemetry = source.map(record => ({
    index: Number(record.index),
    powerEntity: record.powerEntity,
    socEntity: record.socEntity,
    power: Number.isFinite(Number(record.power)) ? Number(record.power) : null,
    soc: Number.isFinite(Number(record.soc)) ? Number(record.soc) : null,
    powerAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.powerAgeMs)) ? Number(record.powerAgeMs) : null,
    socAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.socAgeMs)) ? Number(record.socAgeMs) : null,
    powerUpdatedMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.powerUpdatedMs)) ? Number(record.powerUpdatedMs) : null,
    socUpdatedMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.socUpdatedMs)) ? Number(record.socUpdatedMs) : null,
    powerNumeric: record.powerNumeric === true,
    socNumeric: record.socNumeric === true,
    powerFresh: record.powerFresh === true,
    socFresh: record.socFresh === true,
    chargingCutoffEntity: record.chargingCutoffEntity || '',
    dischargingCutoffEntity: record.dischargingCutoffEntity || '',
    rs485Entity: record.rs485Entity || '',
    rs485State: String(record.rs485State || 'unknown'),
    rs485Available: record.rs485Available === true,
    rs485Enabled: record.rs485Enabled === true,
    telemetryUsable: record.telemetryUsable === true,
    chargingCutoff: Number.isFinite(Number(record.chargingCutoff)) ? Number(record.chargingCutoff) : null,
    dischargingCutoff: Number.isFinite(Number(record.dischargingCutoff)) ? Number(record.dischargingCutoff) : null,
    atChargingCutoff: record.atChargingCutoff === true,
    atDischargingCutoff: record.atDischargingCutoff === true,
    boundaryIdle: record.boundaryIdle === true,
    activePower: record.activePower === true,
    heartbeatAgeMs: Number.isFinite(Number(record.heartbeatAgeMs)) ? Number(record.heartbeatAgeMs) : null,
    heartbeatFresh: record.heartbeatFresh === true,
    freshnessMode: String(record.freshnessMode || 'unknown'),
    usable: record.usable === true,
    faults: Array.isArray(record.faults) ? record.faults.map(String) : []
}));

hpvc.hbcBatteryTelemetry = hbcBatteryTelemetry;
msg.hpvc = hpvc;
return msg;

name: Assemble Shared HPVC Report Model
func:
// Assemble the canonical report model consumed by both TXT and HTML renderers.
const haStates = msg.hpvcReportSnapshot || {};
function item(entity) { return entity && haStates[entity] ? haStates[entity] : null; }
function state(entity, fallback = 'unavailable') {
    const value = item(entity);
    return value && value.state !== undefined ? String(value.state) : fallback;
}
function num(entity, fallback = null) {
    const raw = state(entity, '');
    const text = String(raw).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (['', 'unknown', 'unavailable', 'none'].includes(text)) return fallback;
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}
function finite(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return false;
    if (typeof value === 'string' && ['', 'unknown', 'unavailable', 'none'].includes(value.trim().toLowerCase())) return false;
    return Number.isFinite(Number(value));
}
function safeJson(raw, fallback = {}) {
    try {
        return JSON.parse(String(raw || ''));
    } catch (_) {
        return fallback;
    }
}
function formatDateTime(value) {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return 'unavailable';
    const d = new Date(date); const p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${p(d.getDate())}-${p(d.getMonth()+1)}-${d.getFullYear()} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}:${p(d.getSeconds())}`;
}
function rating(value) {
    if (!finite(value)) return 'No data collected today';
    const number = Number(value);
    if (number >= 90) return 'Excellent';
    if (number >= 80) return 'Great';
    if (number >= 65) return 'Good';
    if (number >= 50) return 'Fair';
    return 'Needs attention';
}
const timeFromMs = value => Number(value) > 0 ? formatDateTime(Number(value)) : 'unavailable';
const {
    version,
    reportTimeZone,
    generatedAt,
    generated,
    debug,
    accuracyDiagnostics,
    inverterDiagnostics,
    batteryDiagnostics,
    chargePriorityDiagnostics,
    pendingVerification,
    lastWriteResults,
    verificationPending,
    verificationStatus,
    enabled,
    hbcControl,
    statusValue,
    reasonValue,
    currentAction,
    grid,
    pv,
    market,
    allIn,
    settings,
    pvLimited,
    cooldown,
    negativeMode,
    configValid,
    hbcAvailable,
    gridError,
    decision,
    runtimeInvSource,
    configuredInverterCount,
    configuredInvSource,
    invSource,

    inverters,
    unavailableCount,
    inverterSummary,
    batteries,
    configuredGridEntity,
    configuredPvEntity,
    configuredMarketEntity,
    configuredAllInEntity,
    sensorHealth,
    pvHealthEntry,
    sunBelowHorizon,
    insights,
    reportDateKey,
    insightCandidates,
    insightSources,
    previousReportInsightLog,
    currentDayInsightLog,
    uniqueInsights,
    insightHistoryCapped,
    insightHistorySourceBase,
    insightHistorySource,
    generatedDate,
    activityCutoff,
    rawActivity,
    rawActivityMeta,
    activityDateKey,
    allActivityRows,
    priceZoneTransitions,
    priceZoneIntervals,
    openPriceZoneAt,
    currentPriceZoneState,
    activityRows,
    activitySummary,
    priorMode,
    limitGridWeighted,
    limitSamples,
    chargeIntervals,
    limitIntervals,
    groupedInsightsChronological,
    reportInsights,
    groupedInsights,
    rawSeverity,
    insightSummary,
    targetAccuracy,
    factors,
    chargePriorityStateRaw,
    chargePriorityEntityState,
    chargePriorityLegacyActive,
    diagnosticChargePriorityState,
    chargePriorityState,
    chargePriorityActive,
    chargePriorityRequested,
    taperProbeActive,
    controlMode,
    actionResult,
    runtimeDiagnosticTimestamps,

    runtimeDiagnosticsSkewSeconds,

const factor = keys => { for (const key of keys) if (finite(factors?.[key])) return Number(factors[key]); return 0; };
const hbcDiagnosticsTime = timeFromMs(batteryDiagnostics.ts);
const hbcDiagnosticsAgeSeconds = Number(batteryDiagnostics.ts) > 0

// retaining the package's raw negative-is-charging convention internally.
// Keep the internal activity sequence oldest-to-newest for duration, session,
// and energy calculations. Reverse only the report-facing copy so the newest
// Power Control event appears first in both HTML and TXT reports.
const activityModeAliases = {
    'Limit': 'PV Limited',
    'Restore': 'PV Restore',

    .replace(/^Inverter limit \+(\d+) W$/, 'Inverter limit increased by $1 W')

    mode: activityModeAliases[row.mode] || row.mode,
    action: normalizeActivityAction(row.action),
    battery: finite(row.battery) ? Math.max(0, -Number(row.battery)) : null

    accuracy: { value: targetAccuracy, rating: rating(targetAccuracy), factors: { control: factor(['tctrlp','controlResponse','control_response']), load: factor(['thloadp','houseLoadChanges','house_load_changes']), pv: factor(['tpvavailp','pvAvailability','pv_availability']), other: factor(['totherp','other']) } },
    inverters, inverterSummary, settings,
    hbc: { available: hbcAvailable, control: hbcControl, chargePriorityState, chargePriorityRequested, chargePriorityActive, taperProbeActive, strategy: state('input_select.house_battery_strategy'), chargeGoal: state('input_select.house_battery_strategy_charge_goal'), executing: state('input_text.house_battery_strategy_active_sub_strategy'), negativeOverrideState: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.state || 'inactive', negativeOverrideReason: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.reason || 'Negative all-in override inactive.', negativeOverrideLockActive: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.lockActive === true, negativeOverrideAllInValid: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.allInValid === true, negativeOverrideSavedStrategy: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.savedStrategy || '', negativeOverrideSavedChargeGoal: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.savedChargeGoal || '', negativeOverrideLastCallStep: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.lastCallStep || '', negativeOverrideLastCallAt: Number(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.lastCallAt || 0), negativeOverridePhaseStartedAt: Number(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.phaseStartedAt || 0), negativeOverridePhaseAgeSeconds: Number(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.phaseAgeSeconds || 0), negativeOverrideRetryCount: Number(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.retryCount || 0), negativeOverrideFaultActive: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.faultActive === true, negativeOverrideFaultPublishedAt: Number(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.faultPublishedAt || 0), negativeOverrideLastCallError: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.lastCallError || '', negativeOverridePersistenceReady: negativeOverrideDiagnostics.persistenceReady === true, negativeOverrideInverterDrift: Array.isArray(negativeOverrideDiagnostics.inverterMinimumDrift) ? negativeOverrideDiagnostics.inverterMinimumDrift : [], usableCount: batteryDiagnostics.usableCount ?? batteries.length,
        uncertainExcluded: batteryDiagnostics.uncertainExcluded ?? batteryDiagnostics.staleExcluded ?? 0,

        stateReason: chargePriorityDiagnostics.displayReason || chargePriorityDiagnostics.reason || reasonValue,
        eligibleBatteryCount: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.eligibleBatteryCount) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.eligibleBatteryCount) : batteries.filter(b => b.priorityEligible).length,
        below90EligibleCount: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.below90EligibleCount) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.below90EligibleCount) : batteries.filter(b => b.priorityEligible && b.socMode === 'Normal').length,
        taperEligibleCount: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.taperEligibleCount) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.taperEligibleCount) : batteries.filter(b => b.priorityEligible && b.socMode === 'Taper-aware').length,
        combinedBatteryHeadroom: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.combinedBatteryHeadroom) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.combinedBatteryHeadroom) : batteries.reduce((sum,b)=>sum+(finite(b.headroomContribution)?Number(b.headroomContribution):0),0),

        taperBatteryAllowance: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.taperBatteryAllowance) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.taperBatteryAllowance) : batteries.reduce((sum,b)=>sum+(finite(b.taperReleaseAllowance)?Number(b.taperReleaseAllowance):0),0),

        netAbsorbableHeadroom: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.netAbsorbableHeadroom) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.netAbsorbableHeadroom) : null,
        remainingInverterCapacity: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.remainingInverterCapacity) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.remainingInverterCapacity) : Math.max(0,inverterSummary.maximumTotal-inverterSummary.currentTotal),
        stepCap: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.stepCap) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.stepCap) : null,
        calculatedIncrease: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.calculatedIncrease) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.calculatedIncrease) : null,
        targetTotal: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.targetTotal) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.targetTotal) : null,
        deadband: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.deadband) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.deadband) : settings.deadband,
        prioritizedBattery: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.prioritizedBattery) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.prioritizedBattery) : 0,
        batteryOrder: Array.isArray(chargePriorityDiagnostics.batteryOrder) ? chargePriorityDiagnostics.batteryOrder.map(Number) : [],

        responseWindowMs: finite(chargePriorityDiagnostics.responseWindowMs) ? Number(chargePriorityDiagnostics.responseWindowMs) : 15000,

    batteries, sensorHealth, insights: reportInsights, groupedInsights, insightSummary,
